about: Annotated sentences for the helper, modal and contraction rules (SPEC.md S16). Identical in lingleaf-ios and lingleaf-android. Each rule must be right in at least 95% of the cases where it fires, over at least 30 cases where it is expected. source: a bundled story, a Project Gutenberg book id (quoted from that book), or 'constructed' (written to test a known trap). use null means an ordinary word (no note). source 'heldout': written by a separate reviewer from the annotation rules only, without the code.
